reuse.why: Hooks the new rule into the existing pre-link guard that all six provider linkers already call before any side effect.

duplication.why: The closed-account check is written once; no per-provider copies.

placement.why: It sits in the shared pre-link validation in accounts/app.ts, the right layer, but inside a function named assertBankAccountNotLinked, which now asserts an unrelated condition too.

scope.why: A single minimal hunk; nothing unrelated touched.

maintainability.why: Very small and covers every path, but the guard's name no longer describes what it checks, and no tests accompany the change.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by all six link*Account functions
